title: Southern California braced for fierce storm after record rain in San Francisco
summary_full: Planes temporarily grounded, roads flooded and tens of thousands lose power, with evacuations in south of stateSouthern California braced for the arrival of a fierce winter storm that already set records for rainfall in the north of the state.Los Angeles authorities urged residents in the Palisades, Hurst and Sunset burn scar areas to leave before the storm’s arrival on Thursday, and warned of a risk of debris flows and flooding.
